title: Approval
description: A first-class approval-gate record (spec section 28). Machine-emitted JSON runtime record, so field names are snake_case. MVP behavior (spec section 28): local graphical approval, keyboard approve/deny, expiration, audit, typed capability execution after approval. Status lifecycle: pending -> approved | denied | expired.

approval_id.title: Approval id
approval_id.description: Unique approval identifier with 'apr_' prefix, e.g. 'apr_123' (spec section 28).

type.title: Requester type
type.description: Kind of principal making the request, e.g. 'ai_agent' (spec sections 18, 28).

id.title: Requester id
id.description: Identifier of the requesting principal (spec section 28). For 'ai_agent' requesters this is an agent session id with 'agt_' prefix, e.g. 'agt_123' (spec section 19.2); other principal kinds use their own identifier forms.

user.title: User
user.description: Human user the approval is routed to for an approve/deny decision, e.g. 'alice@acme.com' (spec section 28).

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Capability being requested, dotted snake_case capability id, e.g. 'system.install_package' (spec sections 28, 41).

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Concrete resource the capability would act on, e.g. 'libvirt' (spec section 28).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable justification supplied by the requester, e.g. 'required by project Atlas' (spec section 28).

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: Assessed risk level of granting the request: low, medium, or high (spec sections 28, 41).

status.title: Status
status.description: Approval lifecycle status (spec section 28). 'pending' until the user approves or denies (keyboard approve/deny) or the request passes expires_at; typed capability execution proceeds only after 'approved'.

expires_at.title: Expires at
expires_at.description: RFC 3339 time after which a pending approval automatically expires (spec section 28; the spec example elides the value as "...").
